testcase.name: a document is safe exactly when sanitizing removes nothing()
sample data with unknown fields, URLs, credentials or too many rows is dropped()
sanitizing does not change its input and a legacy page is returned as it was()
every scope drops the publish draft and the connector id but keeps the slot()
third-party extension namespaces never travel in a SYSTEM template()
operation keys of a tenant connector are removed only from platform-wide templates()
the sample V2 document becomes a valid platform template()
scope follows the visibility of the template()
credential-like keys and URLs in an extension remove that namespace in every scope()
